method: Actual PNG viewed in the independent child context; complete actual submitted sidecar prompt/history and batch source contracts compared with current source template/handlers and matching real baseline where available. No generation or product runtime tests.
selectedState: Three independent heading/table/color pickers with two separate custom HEX value states

functionalFindings.finding: The second and third rows of the fixed36-color palette are swapped: the raster puts bright/medium tints in row2 and very light tints in row3, while actual rows and accessible names are base/light/bright/dark. Preset location and keyboard9-column navigation therefore no longer select the existing source-mapped color.

fieldActionRoleStateChecks: Actually viewed full current PNG/prompt/contracts. Heading body/H1..H6 list and H2 selected/focused; table3x3 numeric row/column fields, current preset, first-header preview, bounds help and valid insertion/cancel match source.

Color default/current-blue and custom invalid#12 with disabled apply plus independent valid#2563EB with enabled apply are accurate. No native picker/extra confirm/transparent selector invented; HEX normalizes3/6 digits and optional prefix by source.

styleFindings.finding: Raster texture/shading and approximate geometry remain illustrative. Use shared flat CSS tokens and source conditional scrolling/focus/disabled behavior; no exact CSS or responsive/runtime compliance claimed.

requiredCorrections: Swap only the two middle rows of nine color presets so source order is base, very light(浅), bright(亮), dark. Preserve columns black/gray/blue/cyan/green/red/orange/yellow/purple, current base-blue check, both independent HEX states and all heading/table controls. This is fixed color/keyboard binding fidelity, not an absolute raster/CSS pixel-color precision demand.
limitations: Static design review does not prove API execution, permissions, dirty/busy/close guards, focus/keyboard, persistence, canvas topology or responsive fit.
Only declared compatible state reviewed; hidden mutually exclusive branches remain separate mappings. Source-derived examples are not captured runtime results.
